title: Characteristic Function Limit from the Second Moment
statement: Let $X$ be a real random variable on a probability space, measurable up to a null set, with finite second moment, mean zero, and second moment $q$. If $\varphi$ is its characteristic function, then $\varphi(1/\sqrt{n})^n\to\exp(-q/2)$ as the positive integer $n$ tends to infinity.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying measure is a probability measure
